• Unordered, records/s at workMicros 0 / 100 / 1000: KPipe 916k / 658k / 644k, Atleon 797k / 646k / 631k, raw 1.07M / 780k / 773k.
• KPipe ÷ Atleon: 1.15x / 1.02x / 1.02x unordered, 0.98x / 1.06x / 0.89x per key. KPipe ÷ raw: 0.86x / 0.84x / 0.83x.
• gc.count and gc.time are totals for the measurement window, so faster arms run more invocations and collect more.
Per-partition arms and the single-threaded baseline are omitted: different guarantee. Full table: benchmarks/results/2026-10-16-ci-parallel-jmh137.md
